title: Feature flag + config plumbing for KV cache compaction (enablement, budgets, eviction mode); default off
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Context
We need to ship KV cache compaction + new eviction policy behind safe runtime flags to support staged canary by region/pool and quick rollback during tail-latency incidents. Default behavior must remain identical to current runtime (no compaction; existing eviction behavior).

Scope
- Add runtime flag/config schema for:
  1) enabling compaction (default OFF)
  2) configuring compaction triggers + budgets (to protect median latency)
  3) selecting eviction mode (legacy vs new v1) and its tunables
- Ensure flags are overrideable per region/pool (Hosted) and per Dedicated pool.
- Ensure changes are safe under concurrency (no mid-kernel pointer instability). Where a setting is not safe to apply immediately, it must apply at a well-defined boundary (e.g., next scheduling epoch / next compaction interval) and log that fact.
- Add “effective config” structured logging so SRE can confirm what’s active on a pool.

Non-goals
- Implementing compaction itself (ENG-2847/PRs) or eviction selection logic (ENG-2845).
- Console UX; this is runtime-side config/flag plumbing only.

Proposed config keys (names are the contract; final names must be documented and stable)
Compaction
- kv_cache.compaction.enabled: bool (default: false)
- kv_cache.compaction.trigger_mode: enum ["disabled", "threshold", "on_alloc_failure", "threshold_or_failure"] (default: "disabled")
- kv_cache.compaction.fragmentation_threshold: float (0.0–1.0) (default: 0.35)  # only used for threshold modes
- kv_cache.compaction.interval_ms: int (default: 250)  # budget window
- kv_cache.compaction.budget_us_per_interval: int (default: 150)  # hard cap on compaction work per interval
- kv_cache.compaction.max_bytes_moved_per_interval: int (default: 268435456)  # 256 MiB cap (guardrail)
- kv_cache.compaction.min_free_blocks_target: int (default: 0)  # optional: stop early when allocator is “healthy”
- kv_cache.compaction.apply_boundary: enum ["epoch", "interval"] (default: "epoch")  # how we apply config changes safely

Eviction
- kv_cache.eviction.mode: enum ["legacy", "v1_tiered_fair"] (default: "legacy")
- kv_cache.eviction.v1.max_victims_per_cycle: int (default: 128)
- kv_cache.eviction.v1.fairness_floor_tokens: int (default: 2048)  # prevent starvation; exact semantics owned by ENG-2845/2846
- kv_cache.eviction.v1.protect_prefix_cache: bool (default: true)
- kv_cache.eviction.v1.tenant_tier_weights: string (default: "free=1,pro=2,enterprise=3")  # parsed/validated

Operational guardrails
- kv_cache.safety.fail_open_on_parse_error: bool (default: true)  # if config is malformed, log + keep last-good config
- kv_cache.safety.log_effective_config_interval_s: int (default: 60)

Implementation notes
- Integrate with runtime config loader and per-pool overrides (Hosted + Dedicated).
- Validate all numeric ranges at load time; clamp only if explicitly agreed with SRE (prefer “reject + keep last-good config”).
- Make “disable” a single-step rollback:
  - set kv_cache.compaction.enabled=false OR kv_cache.compaction.trigger_mode="disabled"
  - set kv_cache.eviction.mode="legacy"
- Add structured log event (once per minute per worker) with:
  - enabled state
  - trigger_mode
  - budgets
  - eviction mode
  - config version/hash
  - region/pool identifiers

Acceptance criteria
- Default OFF: with no config set, runtime behavior matches current (no compaction activity; eviction remains legacy).
- Config can be applied per region/pool and shows up in “effective config” logs.
- Runtime rejects malformed config safely (keeps last-good; emits explicit error log + metric).
- Unit tests for parsing/validation + “default off” behavior.
- Docs in-code (flag help strings) are present and accurate enough for SRE runbook/canary checklist to reference.

Links
- Umbrella project: ENG-2841
- Design doc: sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/kernel-and-scheduling/kv-cache-compaction-improvements-design-v1.json
- ADRs: ADR-0127 / ADR-0128 / ADR-0129

Progress updates
2025-03-02 (Benji Okafor)
- Drafted config schema and validator; aligning enum names with runtime modules to avoid “two sources of truth”.
- Open question: do we require an epoch boundary for enable/disable, or allow immediate disable only? Leaning: allow immediate disable (stop scheduling new compaction work), but apply enable at epoch boundary.

2025-03-06 (Rafael Mendes)
- SRE request: rollback must be a single config push and must not require restarting workers. Also want a metric for “config_parse_error_total{pool,region}” and “effective_compaction_enabled{pool,region}”.

2025-03-09 (Benji Okafor)
- Added last-good config caching and parse error metric stub. Remaining: wire per-pool override source + finalize defaults with Omar/Sofia so canary has conservative budgets.
